kind: logistic regression, L2 (C=0.1), all simple metrics
label: win = price reached +20% before -25% within 60 min of the evaluation price (timeout = 0), DexScreener/Jupiter quotes, before costs

training.population: tradeable rows of scoring.db: past the age+liquidity stages, pool liquidity > 0, mcap/liq >= 1.3; one row per coin per 30 min

inputs: the bot's evaluation metrics dict (scanner metrics JSON stored in evaluations.metrics) + chain + bucket
pipeline: raw = feature definition (below) from the metrics dict; undefined/None/non-finite -> missing
x = min(max(raw, clip_low), clip_high)  (missing stays missing)
logit = intercept + sum(coef * z);  prob = 1 / (1 + exp(-logit));  score = round(prob * 100, 1)

features.name: log_liq
features.definition: log10(metrics['liq']) - pool liquidity USD (DexScreener liquidity.usd); missing if liq is None or <= 0

features.name: log_vol_h1
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['vol_h1']) - 1h volume USD; missing if None or < 0

features.name: log_vol_h24
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['vol_h24']) - 24h volume USD; missing if None or < 0

features.name: vol_liq
features.definition: slog(vol_h1 / liq); missing if vol_h1 is None or liq is None or <= 0

features.name: vol_h1_share
features.definition: vol_h1 / vol_h24 (share of the day's volume done in the last hour); missing if vol_h24 is None or <= 0

features.name: mcap_liq
features.definition: slog(mcap / liq); missing if mcap or liq is None or <= 0

features.name: log_age_min
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['age_min']) - pool age in minutes; missing if None or < 0

features.name: log_buys_h1
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['buys_h1']); missing if None or < 0

features.name: log_sells_h1
features.definition: ln(1 + metrics['sells_h1']); missing if None or < 0

features.name: bs_ratio
features.definition: slog(buys_h1 / max(sells_h1, 1)); missing if buys_h1 or sells_h1 is None

features.name: chg_h1
features.definition: slog(metrics['chg_h1']) - 1h price change %; missing if None

features.name: chg_m5
features.definition: slog(metrics['chg_m5']) - 5m price change %; missing if None

features.name: chg_h24
features.definition: slog(metrics['chg_h24']) - 24h price change %; missing if None

domain_guard: if liq > 0 and mcap > 0 and mcap / liq < 1.3: out of model domain (liquidity ~= market cap pools). score_v1 returns score 0.0, prob 0.0
output: score 0-100 = probability x 100 (NOT on the same scale as the current 0-100 score; do not compare thresholds)
top10pct_use: stricter gate for the new account while a soft daily cap is active (Trading Bot's 'score >= 75, half size' rule); same basis as below but the 90th percentile
threshold_basis: 80th percentile of this model's score on 99 test-period rows (2026-10-03T09:59-04:00 onward) that reached the bot's score gate -> about the top 20% of coins the gate sees
warnings: Validation test set is one morning (Oct 3 after ~10 AM): treat the threshold as provisional and re-fit after ~10 more days of data.
plain_words: Higher score for coins doing a lot of their volume right now (1h volume, 1h volume vs 24h, volume vs liquidity), with more buys than sells, that are younger, not spiking in the last 5 minutes, and with fewer raw trade counts for the same volume (bigger average trades). Buy (new account) when score >= threshold.
